chapter: Boyhood in Evergreen and Calhoun school
title: His Harris half-brothers and sister
summary: He names the half-siblings: Sam (S.J.), H.B., Theophilus and Edith Harris; Sam started him on the peck horn and Theophilus helped.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now which of your brothers was it who had the peck horn that you --
That was -- his name was Sammy. He was named after his grandfather, S. J. We -- because they had so many long names in between.
We called him S. J., another one was called H. B. He's the only one that didn't bother with the music, and another brother, Theophilus, the same Greek lady named him.
Edith. Well, that's a simple name. Now their last name wasn't Autrey, I suppose.
Harris, I see. And so it was Sam Harris who actually got you started with the peck horn.
Yeah, uh-huh, and then Theophilus, he helped me quite a bit.
